ios.desc:
A beautiful local music file player — MP3, FLAC, WAV, and more — with an equalizer, widgets, Timed Lyrics, CarPlay support, and more. Designed for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. Now free for up to 80 songs.

A Lovely Home for Your Music
Put your high-quality music file collection in one of the nicest UIs out there.

See It Shine
Clutter-free interface with big, beautiful artwork, and clean typography.

Glide Through It
Navigate with silky-smooth gestures and handy shortcuts to find things fast.

Queue It Up
Easily queue up songs to play next, and edit the upcoming list with Up Next.

Search, Fast
Pull down from anywhere in your library to invoke Search, and use the Return key to select the top result.

On Your Watch
Sync music from your iPhone and take it with you, offline on your Apple Watch.

Connect Between Devices
Besides Apple Watch, Doppi runs on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. You can transfer music and 'follow' another device's contents. 

Follow Remote Folders
Doppi can add any folder you can see in the Files app, including those in a cloud provider or NAS, and automatically download their new files.

Make Playlists
Create playlists and add songs with multitouch drag-and-drop.

Edit Metadata
Change information like title, artist, album, lyrics, artwork, and more on your music files.

Now Playing Widget
Large artwork and playback controls (while playing), available in 3 sizes.

Equalizer
Enjoy your way with an 8-band 6-preset (+ Custom) equalizer, available right on the player menu.

Timed Lyrics
Have a sing-along! LRC-formatted timed lyrics are shown synced to the music.

Get Lyrics
Doppi can (try to) automatically fetch lyrics for you! Just tap Get Lyrics.

Make It Your Own
Choose from 6 preset highlight colors or a custom one, 4 light and dark themes, several icon variations, pick your library sections and their order, and more.

Hello Tab
Your most loved, most played, and most recent albums and artists: all in one place.

CarPlay
Drive safely and enjoy your music from the intuitive Doppi interface for CarPlay.

Scrobble to Last.fm
Log into your Last.fm account from Settings to start sending your Doppi plays to the service.

After This Song
Choose what you want to happen when the current song ends: pause, shuffle all, play a playlist, and more.

Continue With Album
Ever shuffled your music, found a song you loved, and wished you could continue the album instead? Doppi can make it happen, from After This Song.

Ask Siri to DJ
Your assistant can play
